title: 对话中的口语表达
goal: 能结合上下文理解口语表达及回应意图。

points.label: 识别口语表达的语境义
依据口语表达判断回应意图

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲
sources.used: 课程内容依据的考试大纲

body.p: 口语表达的意思要结合上下文判断。委婉的回应可以是同意、拒绝，也可以是保留意见。

body.box:
A: Can we meet today?
B: I'm afraid I can't. I'm away until tomorrow.

body.p: I'm afraid 在这里引出拒绝，意思不是害怕。拒绝的原因是今天不在。

cards.title: 同意与反对
rows: A: Shall we share the notes? B: I'm all for it.
A: Meet at noon? B: That works for me.
A: The route is too long. B: I couldn't agree more.
A: A smaller room costs less. B: You have a point.
A: The instructions need examples. B: I'm with you on that.
A: The repair will be quick. B: I'm not so sure.
A: The sign is clear. B: I see it differently.
A: Shall we postpone? B: I'd rather not.
A: The plan is complete. B: I'm afraid I disagree.
A: Let's label each box. B: That makes sense.
cards.note: You have a point 只承认对方说的这一点有道理。是否接受整个方案，看后面的话。

cards.title: 困难与变化
rows: A: How did the repair go? B: We ran into trouble with a loose wire.
A: Is the order ready? B: We hit a snag with the address.
A: Can we print more? B: We're short of paper.
A: Is there any glue? B: We've run out of it.
A: Is the draft on schedule? B: We've fallen behind.
A: Can we finish the draft? B: We can catch up tomorrow.
A: How was the trip? B: It turned out well.
A: Did the exchange succeed? B: Yes, it worked out.
A: Why did you leave early? B: Something came up at home.
A: Is the venue fixed? B: It's still up in the air.
cards.note: be short of 表示不足；run out of 表示已经用完。

cards.title: 安排与期限
rows: A: Can we meet today? B: Let's put it off until Friday.
A: Can we meet sooner? B: Let's bring the meeting forward.
A: When can we review it? B: I'll set aside an hour.
A: Is Tuesday possible? B: I'll pencil it in.
A: Are we ordering now? B: Let's put the order on hold.
A: Is the model ready? B: Yes, we're ahead of schedule.
A: Is the model ready? B: No, we're behind schedule.
A: Can you attend tomorrow? B: Yes, even at short notice.
A: The parts arrive Friday. B: In the meantime, I'll check the plans.
A: When is the summary due? B: By the end of Monday.
cards.note: pencil in 是暂定，之后还要确认。

cards.title: 建议与决定
rows: A: The path is closed. B: Why don't we take the other path?
A: We need a venue. B: How about the hall?
A: The screen is dim. B: It might be worth checking the settings.
A: Which design is clearer? B: I'd go with the simpler one.
A: Should we change the date? B: Let's stick with Friday.
A: Who will contact the driver? B: Leave it to me.
A: Have you chosen a room? B: I haven't made up my mind.
A: Will you join the panel? B: I'll give it some thought.
A: Is the small van suitable? B: The narrow door rules it out.
A: Are we using the new sign? B: Yes, let's go ahead with it.
cards.note: give it some thought 是答应考虑，还没有决定接不接受。

items.stem: Mia says, 'We're short of labels, but there are a few left.' What does she mean?
options: The labels have all been used.
The labels are not sufficient.
The labels have been ordered.
The labels are enough for now.
items.why: a few left 表明标签仍有剩余，short of 表示数量不足。

items.stem: Lee asks whether to change the route. Sam replies, 'Let's stick with the old route.' What does Sam suggest?
options: Continuing with the existing route
Testing a shorter replacement route
Postponing the choice of a route
Asking Lee to design a new route
items.why: stick with the old route 表示继续采用原路线。

items.stem: Ava says, 'The venue is still up in the air.' What is the status of the venue?
options: It has been reserved for later.
It has been moved to another site.
It has not yet been decided.
It has not been discussed yet.
items.why: up in the air 表示地点尚未确定。

items.stem: Nora asks Ben to join a panel. Ben replies, 'I'll give it some thought.' What does Ben intend?
options: To decline the panel invitation
To accept the panel invitation
To suggest another panel member
To consider the panel invitation
items.why: give it some thought 表示考虑邀请，尚未作出决定。

items.stem: The editor says, 'The draft is ahead of schedule.' What is its status?
options: It is further along than planned.
It is later than originally planned.
It is on hold until the planned date.
It is scheduled to begin tomorrow.
items.why: ahead of schedule 表示进度快于计划。

items.stem: Ari asks about changing the venue. Mo says, 'I'm not so sure the other room is suitable.' What does Mo express?
options: A firm decision to book the room
A reservation about the other room
Agreement to change the venue
Certainty that the room is unsuitable
items.why: I'm not so sure 表示对另一房间是否合适有保留。

lines.text: The order is nearly ready, but the address seems incomplete. Shall we send it now?
Let's put it on hold until we confirm the address. I'll contact the customer this afternoon.

items.stem: What does the second speaker suggest?
options: Sending the order to the address now
Holding the order until the address is checked
Asking the customer to collect the order
Changing the address without contacting the customer
items.why: put it on hold until we confirm the address 表示核实地址前暂缓发送。

items.stem: What does 'put it on hold' mean here?
options: Send the order this afternoon
Send the order to the customer
Temporarily delay the order
Prepare a replacement order
items.why: put it on hold 表示暂缓处理订单。

lines.text: The volunteer group needs a place for the workshop. The library has a room, but it is smaller than the community hall. Which would you choose?
I'd go with the library room. It's available this weekend, and we only have a small group. Let's ask the librarian to reserve it.

items.stem: What does the second speaker recommend?
options: Waiting for the community hall
Choosing the library room
Increasing the size of the group
Moving the workshop to another weekend
items.why: I'd go with the library room 表示建议选择图书馆的房间。

items.stem: Why does the second speaker consider the room suitable?
options: It is available and the group is small.
It is larger than the community hall.
It has already been reserved for the group.
It is available only on weekdays.
items.why: available this weekend 和 only have a small group 是选择该房间的依据。

lines.text: Are the labels ready for the museum display? We hoped to finish them before the cases arrive on Friday.
We're behind schedule because the translations arrived late. We can catch up tomorrow if the printer works. The cases are still due on Friday.

items.stem: What does 'behind schedule' indicate?
options: The labels are complete ahead of the cases.
The translations are due after the cases.
The cases have arrived earlier than planned.
The labels are progressing later than planned.
items.why: behind schedule 表示标签制作进度落后。

items.stem: What does the second speaker expect may happen tomorrow?
options: The group may stop translating the labels.
The cases may be sent back to the printer.
The group may recover the lost time.
The translations may arrive tomorrow.
items.why: We can catch up tomorrow 表示明天可能赶上进度。

items.stem: Ella says, 'The revised design makes sense.' What does Ella mean?
options: She has a reservation about the design.
She finds the design reasonable.
She plans to revise the design.
She considers the design unfinished.
items.why: makes sense 表示认为修改后的设计有道理。

items.stem: Owen says, 'We ran out of paint after finishing the door.' What happened?
options: The paint was used up.
The paint was set aside.
The paint was ordered again.
The paint was used on the floor.
items.why: ran out of paint 表示漆已经用完。

items.stem: Lia asks about meeting on Thursday. Max says, 'I'll pencil it in and confirm tomorrow.' What does Max intend?
options: To cancel the Thursday meeting
To confirm the meeting immediately
To move the meeting to tomorrow
To reserve Thursday provisionally
items.why: pencil it in 加上 confirm tomorrow 表示暂定周四。

items.stem: Rae says, 'The delivery is behind schedule.' What does she mean?
options: The delivery was sent ahead of time.
The delivery is later than planned.
The delivery is scheduled for today.
The delivery has been put on hold.
items.why: behind schedule 表示交付晚于计划。

items.stem: Kim asks whether to choose the larger sign. Jo says, 'I'd go with the smaller one.' What does Jo recommend?
options: Keeping both signs in the design
Asking for a new sign design
Choosing the smaller sign
Delaying the choice of sign
items.why: I'd go with the smaller one 表示倾向选择较小的标牌。

items.stem: The technician says, 'We hit a snag with the cable.' What does this mean?
options: The cable caused a difficulty.
The cable repair is complete.
The cable was replaced on time.
The cable has been set aside.
items.why: hit a snag 表示遇到障碍，问题出在电缆上。

lines.text: The exhibition room is available on Friday. Do you think we should use it, or wait for the larger hall?
I'm all for using the room. We can arrange the displays there without waiting for the hall. I'll contact the caretaker today, and we can confirm the layout tomorrow.

items.stem: How does the second speaker respond to using the room?
options: By asking to wait for the larger hall
By reserving judgment about the room
By proposing a different exhibition date
By strongly supporting the room option
items.why: I'm all for using the room 表示赞成使用该房间。

items.stem: What does the second speaker plan to do today?
options: Confirm the layout with the caretaker
Contact the person responsible for the room
Move the displays into the larger hall
Wait for the hall to become available
items.why: I'll contact the caretaker today 表示今天联系房间管理员。

lines.text: We're supposed to submit the outline tomorrow, but the figures still need checking. Can we finish tonight?
I'm not so sure. The figures came in late, so we're behind schedule. It might be worth asking for an extra day while we check them.

items.stem: What does the second speaker mean by 'behind schedule'?
options: The figures have arrived earlier than expected.
The outline has already been submitted.
The work is progressing more slowly than planned.
The extra day has already been approved.
items.why: figures came in late 和 behind schedule 表明进度落后。

items.stem: What does the second speaker suggest?
options: Requesting more time to check the figures
Submitting the figures without an outline
Changing the figures to fit the outline
Finishing the checks without requesting time
items.why: It might be worth asking for an extra day 是建议申请额外时间。
